name: Childe Roland to the Dark Tower Came
source:
A playable version of the first few stanzas of Robert Browning's atmospheric fantasy poem.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=24198]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
